records.new_gloss_en: a person who has only recently begun learning a skill or activity
records.reason: The stage of learning does not imply youth.

records.new_gloss_en: relating to electricity or equipment operated using electricity
records.reason: Electric systems and components, not necessarily anything electrically charged.

records.new_gloss_en: happening at a useful or appropriate time
records.reason: Appropriateness of timing, rather than speed alone.

records.new_gloss_en: an official name or title given to a person or thing
records.reason: Designation can also mean selection or appointment, a distinct act.

records.new_gloss_en: a meeting of members of a political party to choose candidates or discuss policy
records.reason: An internal political deliberative meeting, not any public gathering.

records.new_gloss_en: a worker who receives payments from customers
records.reason: The occupation handles payment, not general sales advice.

records.new_gloss_en: a large flat area of land high above surrounding land
records.reason: The figurative no-growth plateau is distinct.

records.new_gloss_en: a place offering treatments for health or relaxation
records.reason: Spa facilities may offer water therapies, not necessarily mineral springs.

records.new_gloss_en: to strike someone or something with force
records.reason: Party noun and harsh verbal criticism differ from physical striking.

records.new_gloss_en: a facility where patients get medical consultation or treatment, usually without an overnight stay
records.reason: Outpatient care is characteristic but not universal.

records.new_gloss_en: a small nail with a broad flat head used to fasten paper or fabric
records.reason: Sailing tack and strategic approach are distinct senses.

records.new_gloss_en: a light enclosed in a protective case, often carried or hung
records.reason: Distinguishes enclosed lights from ordinary bare bulbs.

records.new_gloss_en: soft and thick in texture, or made from fabric with a deep pile
records.reason: Fabric noun and luxurious adjective should not be merged.

records.new_gloss_en: to change a product or service to fit a particular user's needs
records.reason: Personal adaptation, not simply buying a standard model.

records.new_gloss_en: the rate at which something changes with distance or another variable
records.reason: Mathematical derivative, slope and color blend may need separate senses.

records.new_gloss_en: containing a high proportion of fat
records.reason: A derogatory noun use has a distinct register and POS.

records.new_gloss_en: a small computer designed to be carried and used in different places
records.reason: Portability, not mandatory use on a lap.

records.new_gloss_en: a passenger ship that follows a regular route
records.reason: The word can also mean an inner covering or cosmetic product.

records.new_gloss_en: willing to accept opinions, people, or behavior different from one's own
records.reason: Tolerance is acceptance of difference, not unconditional endorsement.

records.new_gloss_en: smooth and often slippery
records.reason: Adjective polished/crafty and noun oil slick may differ.

records.new_gloss_en: to urinate (vulgar slang)
records.reason: Piss off means anger someone and is a distinct phrasal construction.

records.new_gloss_en: a person who is extremely skilled at something
records.reason: Playing-card ace, high score and athletic ace are different senses.

records.new_gloss_en: to clean or dry a surface by rubbing it with a cloth or similar object
records.reason: Physical wiping action; wiping out an entity is different.

records.new_gloss_en: a calculation or estimate of future results
records.reason: Optical and mathematical projection are unrelated to forecasting.

records.new_gloss_en: the state of not being watched or disturbed by others without permission
records.reason: Privacy does not always require secrecy; emphasizes control of intrusion.
